tvādi: [To+ādi] (pu) CL=7 [Tvā+ādi] (1) has a beginning with Te, (Paccaya) which has the beginning with Te and the end with Dāni. (2)  (Paccaya) which has the beginning with Tva. See - Tvādyanta-(1).
tvādyanta: [Tvādi+anta] (ti) CL=7 (1) (Saddā) which has the beginning with Tva. (2) (Saddā) which has the beginning with Te and the end with Paccaya. See - Tvādi-(1).
